title: Language spec pages demo the real DS controls instead of lookalikes
goal: The pages that explain the visual language make their points with hand-drawn imitations of app windows, buttons, dialogs and keycaps, so the explanation and the product disagree. This rebuilds those examples from the real shared parts.
notes: From ux-audit rescan 2026-08-23 ('Lang family'). Pages: language, lang-color, lang-elevation, lang-keyboard, lang-motion, lang-overlays, lang-selection, lang-spacing (+ do/don't label standardization incl lang-resize). Key items: lang-color and lang-elevation fake app windows (inline traffic dots, left-sidebar Layers) become real shells or bare specimens (high); states ladders and buttons use real .btn not .obtn/.lg-obtn; dialogs use .dlg (language .lg-modal, lang-overlays .lo-dlg); lang-overlays .lo-pal to .cpal; lang-keyboard keycaps from DS .kbd/.sc; lang-motion animates real DS components + renames .rail collision; language dock specimen gains the Library group its copy names; lang-spacing renames .rrow .bar collision; lang-selection removes em dashes x5; standardize do/don't label on Don't across the family. Verify 200 + audit-sweep.
acceptance: Every example on the visual language pages is built from real shared components, with no page-local lookalikes
The do and don't captions use one consistent wording across the family
Page-local style names that clash with shared ones are renamed
Every touched page loads without error and passes the automated page sweep
